note: Evidence artifacts deliberately not registered as ledger claims. Every waiver needs a reason; tests/test_verification_ledger.py enforces that. A waiver is retired when its artifact gets a claim; the closure ladder waiver was retired by m6405 after nine missions of living on the promise that a 'primary claim' existed elsewhere (it did not). m6453 widened the coverage rule from file names to directories: an entry ending in '/' waives a whole benchmark harness (no committed artifact at all), which is how the evidence debt E1-E3 below became visible instead of silent. m13812: the capillary_wave directory waiver was converted from 'harness only, no artifact' (E1) into a quantified WITHHELD audit; the waiver stays because an audit that reports an inadmissible run is not a capability claim. m14576 re-cut that work from main and re-ran it at HEAD. m15332: the round-2 study of the same harness (benchmarks/capillary_wave/resolution_criterion.json) is waived on the same ground -- an audit that separates the wall boundary condition from the free-surface CSF force and derives a resolution criterion, with no admissible ladder cell to claim. m17086: the ledger could not be rebuilt at HEAD for ~40 missions (a claim read `runs/`, which the delivery filter strips), so harnesses and artifacts kept landing without a claim and nothing said so. Rebuilding it named 26 new harnesses (62 -> 88) and 26 unregistered files; they are acknowledged here as E1/E2 debt with the closing action spelled out, never as verification. This paragraph and the entries it introduces are the honest state at HEAD, not a new exemption policy.

reasons.benchmarks/capillary_wave/: E1 retired: the directory now commits an artifact, but it is an *audit*, not a physical reading -- benchmarks/capillary_wave/open_surface_audit.json measures that the linear capillary standing wave is not gradable at HEAD (the harness aborts inside 2 periods and the CSF force on an open free surface exceeds the wave's restoring acceleration by ~2 orders of magnitude). It therefore registers no claim by design; the WITHHELD verdict lives in docs/verification_capillary_wave_open_surface.md and is gated by tests/test_capillary_wave_open_surface.py.
